data.name: Admiral
data.notes: British variety bred from Challenger and Northdown.

data.name: Agnus
data.notes: Czech variety with Bor, Sládek, Saaz, Northern Brewer and Fuggle in its ancestry.

data.name: Amarillo
data.notes: US variety that arose from open pollination.

data.name: Apollo
data.notes: High-alpha US variety from the Hopsteiner breeding programme.

data.name: Aramis
data.notes: French variety, a daughter of Strisselspalt.

data.name: Archer
data.notes: British low-trellis aroma variety from the Charles Faram hop development programme.

data.name: Ariana
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2016. Pedigree: Herkules x 3W 42-30-38. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang and Spalt.

data.name: Aurora
data.notes: Slovenian variety, a daughter of Northern Brewer.

data.name: Aurum
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 1995; Hüll classes it as a land variety. Pedigree: Tettnanger x 91/036/004.

data.name: Azacca
data.notes: US variety developed by the American Dwarf Hop Association.

data.name: Beata
data.notes: British hedgerow aroma variety bred at Wye College in 1995 for its high beta acid content.

data.name: Boadicea
data.notes: British variety from open pollination of a female descended from a wild Japanese hop.

data.name: Bobek
data.notes: Slovenian variety, a daughter of Savinjski Golding.

data.name: Bramling Cross
data.notes: British variety from Bramling crossed with a seedling of a wild Manitoba hop.

data.name: Brewers Gold
data.notes: British variety from the wild Manitoba hop BB1, open pollinated.

data.name: Bru-1
data.notes: US variety from open pollination at Brulotte Farms in Toppenish, Washington.

data.name: Bullion
data.notes: British variety bred by Prof. Ernest Salmon at Wye College from an open-pollinated wild Manitoba hop (BB1), released in 1938; out of UK production from 1986.

data.name: Callista
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2016. Pedigree: Hallertauer Tradition x 2007/017/501. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Cascade
data.notes: American hop variety from a breeding programme in Oregon, released in 1972. A cross of English Fuggle with a male plant descended from the Russian variety Serebrianka.

data.name: Cascade AU
data.notes: Cascade (USDA) grown in Australia by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: Fuggle, Serebrianka, Native American.

data.name: Cascade DE
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the USDA, released 1972. Pedigree: USDA 19124 x o.p. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt, Elbe-Saale and Baden-Bitburg.

data.name: Cascade NZ
data.notes: Cascade (USDA, 1972) grown in New Zealand and sold by NZ Hops as Taiheke.

data.name: Cascade UK
data.notes: Cascade (USDA) grown in Britain, in production since 2002 from virus-free stock developed through Wye College.

data.name: Cashmere
data.notes: US variety released by Washington State University in 2013, a daughter of Cascade.

data.name: Celeia
data.notes: Slovenian variety, a daughter of Savinjski Golding.

data.name: Centennial
data.notes: US variety; about three quarters of its ancestry is Brewers Gold, with smaller shares of Fuggle, East Kent Golding and a Bavarian hop.

data.name: Chelan
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Galena.

data.name: Chinook
data.notes: US variety from a cross of Petham Golding with a high-alpha USDA male.

data.name: Chinook NZ
data.notes: US variety (USDA, released 1985; Petham Golding x USDA male), here grown in New Zealand.

data.name: Citra
data.notes: US variety whose ancestry is half Hallertau and a quarter US Tettnang.

data.name: Cluster
data.notes: Old US variety of uncertain parentage, possibly an English variety crossed with an American male.

data.name: Columbus
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Nugget.

data.name: Comet DE
data.notes: Variety from open pollination.

data.name: Crystal
data.notes: US variety, a half-sister of Mt. Hood and Liberty.

data.name: Delta
data.notes: US aroma variety from the Hopsteiner breeding programme.

data.name: Deutscher Saazer
data.notes: German land variety (landrace). Grown in Germany in Hallertau and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Diamant
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2020. Pedigree: Spalter x 80/018/062. Grown in Germany in Hallertau.

data.name: Dr. Rudi
data.notes: Triploid variety bred from the New Zealand variety Smoothcone at Plant & Food Research; released in 1976 as Super Alpha and renamed Dr. Rudi in 2012.

data.name: East Kent Golding
data.notes: English variety selected from the wild Canterbury Whitebine.

data.name: Eclipse
data.notes: Australian variety bred by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: Fuggle, Brewer's Gold, Comet, Pride of Ringwood.

data.name: Ekuanot
data.notes: US variety from the Hop Breeding Company, released in 2014 as Equinox (HBC 366) and later renamed.

data.name: Ella
data.notes: Australian variety bred by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: High Alpha Australian, Spalt.

data.name: Endeavour
data.notes: British variety, a seedling of Cascade and a granddaughter of Target.

data.name: Enigma
data.notes: Australian variety bred by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: Swiss Tettnang, North American.

data.name: Epic
data.notes: British variety found in 1987 as a chance seedling in Kent, probably a seedling of Alliance.

data.name: Ernest
data.notes: Historical British variety bred by Prof. Ernest Salmon, on farm trials in 1957-58 but not adopted.

data.name: Extra Styrian Dana
data.notes: Slovenian variety, a daughter of Hallertauer Magnum.

data.name: First Gold
data.notes: British dwarf variety, a daughter of Whitbread Golding and a dwarf male.

data.name: Flyer
data.notes: British low-trellis variety from a 2002 cross of a high-alpha female line and a dwarf male; still on trial according to the British Hop Association.

data.name: Fuggle NZ
data.notes: Fuggle grown in New Zealand.

data.name: Fuggles
data.notes: English land variety.

data.name: Galaxy
data.notes: Australian variety bred by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: High Alpha Australia, Perle.

data.name: Galena
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Brewers Gold.

data.name: Glacier
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Strisselspalt.

data.name: Godiva
data.notes: British variety from the Charles Faram hop development programme, a daughter of Jester.

data.name: Goldings
data.notes: Old English variety group from Kent, including clones such as Cobbs, Eastwell, Mathon and East Kent.

data.name: Green Bullet
data.notes: New Zealand triploid alpha variety from open pollination of Smoothcone, released in 1972.

data.name: Hallertau Blanc
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2012. Pedigree: Cascade x 2004/028/076. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Hallertauer Magnum
data.notes: Bittering variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 1992. Pedigree: Galena x 75/005/003. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Hallertauer Mittelfrüh
data.notes: German land variety (landrace). Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Baden-Bitburg.

data.name: Hallertauer Taurus
data.notes: Bittering variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 1996. Pedigree: 82/39/37 x 85/054/015. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Hallertauer Tradition
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 1992. Pedigree: Hallertauer Gold x 76/015/106. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt, Elbe-Saale and Baden-Bitburg.

data.name: Harlequin
data.notes: British dual-purpose variety from the Charles Faram hop development programme, a daughter of Godiva.

data.name: HBC 472
data.notes: Experimental variety from the Hop Breeding Company.

data.name: HBC 630
data.notes: Experimental variety from the Hop Breeding Company.

data.name: HBC 638
data.notes: Experimental variety from the Hop Breeding Company.

data.name: Herkules
data.notes: Bittering variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2006. Pedigree: Hallertauer Taurus x 93/9/41. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt, Elbe-Saale and Baden-Bitburg.

data.name: Hersbrucker Spät
data.notes: German land variety (landrace). Grown in Germany in Hallertau and Spalt.

data.name: Horizon
data.notes: US variety released in 1998 from a USDA cross of a high-alpha type with an aroma male.

data.name: Huell Melon
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2012. Pedigree: Cascade x 2004/026/007. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Jester
data.notes: British variety from the Charles Faram hop development programme.

data.name: Keyworth's Early
data.notes: Historical British variety bred by Prof. Ernest Salmon at Wye College from a granddaughter of a wild Neomexicanus hop, selected in 1943 for wilt resistance.

data.name: Keyworth's Midseason
data.notes: Historical British variety bred by Prof. Ernest Salmon at Wye College from a daughter of a wild Neomexicanus hop, selected in 1943 for wilt resistance.

data.name: Kohatu

data.name: Loral
data.notes: US variety with Glacier and Nugget in its parentage.

data.name: Lublin
data.notes: Polish variety bred from Saaz.

data.name: Luna
data.notes: Australian variety bred by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: High Alpha Australia, Liberty.

data.name: Magnat
data.notes: Polish variety, a daughter of Magnum.

data.name: Mandarina Bavaria
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2012. Pedigree: Cascade x 2004/026/134. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Marynka
data.notes: Polish variety, a daughter of Brewers Gold.

data.name: Millennium
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Nugget.

data.name: Minstrel
data.notes: British low-trellis, wilt-resistant variety from the Charles Faram hop development programme.

data.name: Monroe
data.notes: Variety derived from a wild American hop.

data.name: Mosaic
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Simcoe and a Nugget-derived male.

data.name: Motueka
data.notes: Seedless triploid aroma variety from Plant & Food Research with Saaz and North American ancestry; crossed 1987, released 1996 as B-Saaz, renamed Motueka in 2007.

data.name: Moutere
data.notes: New Zealand high-alpha triploid variety from Plant & Food Research, bred from Southern Cross and a New Zealand male, released in 2015.

data.name: Mt. Hood
data.notes: US variety bred from Hallertauer Mittelfrüh and Liberty.

data.name: Mystic
data.notes: British variety from the Charles Faram hop development programme, a daughter of Jester.

data.name: Nectaron

data.name: Nelson Sauvin
data.notes: Triploid variety (85-03-06) bred from the New Zealand variety Smoothcone and a New Zealand male at Plant & Food Research; crossed 1985, released 2000.

data.name: Northdown
data.notes: British variety bred at Wye College from Northern Brewer and a downy-mildew-resistant line, released in the early 1970s.

data.name: Northern Brewer DE
data.notes: Aroma variety bred in England. Pedigree: Canterbury Golding x OB 21. Grown in Germany in Hallertau and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Nugget
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Brewers Gold.

data.name: Nugget DE
data.notes: Bittering variety bred by the USDA, released 1978. Pedigree: USDA 65009 x 63015M. Grown in Germany in Hallertau and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Olicana
data.notes: British variety from the Charles Faram hop development programme.

data.name: Opal
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2004. Pedigree: Hallertauer Gold x Ku II/18. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang and Spalt.

data.name: Pacific Gem
data.notes: Triploid alpha variety bred from the New Zealand variety Smoothcone at Plant & Food Research; released in 1987.

data.name: Pacific Jade
data.notes: New Zealand triploid alpha variety from First Choice and an old-line Saazer male, released in 2004.

data.name: Pacifica
data.notes: New Zealand triploid aroma variety from Hallertauer Mittelfrüh and a New Zealand male, released in 1994.

data.name: Perle
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 1978. Pedigree: Northern Brewer x 63/005/027. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt, Elbe-Saale and Baden-Bitburg.

data.name: Phoenix
data.notes: British variety, a seedling of Yeoman bred at Wye College and released in 1996.

data.name: Pilgrim
data.notes: British variety, a half-sister of First Gold, with Challenger and Target in its mother's line.

data.name: Pilot
data.notes: British hedgerow variety bred at Wye College and released in 2001.

data.name: Pioneer
data.notes: British high-alpha hedgerow variety bred at Wye College and released in 1996.

data.name: Polaris
data.notes: Bittering variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2012. Pedigree: 94/075/758 x 97/067/720. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Premiant
data.notes: Czech variety bred from Saaz.

data.name: Progress
data.notes: British variety, a daughter of Whitbread Golding.

data.name: Rakau
data.notes: New Zealand triploid dual-purpose variety from Plant & Food Research, re-released in 2007.

data.name: Relax
data.notes: Variety from the Hüll breeding programme.

data.name: Riwaka
data.notes: New Zealand triploid aroma variety from Plant & Food Research, first released in 1997.

data.name: Saaz Late
data.notes: Czech variety from Saaz semi-early red-bine material, open pollinated.

data.name: Saazer
data.notes: Czech land variety.

data.name: Santiam
data.notes: US aroma variety, one third German Tettnanger and one third Hallertauer Mittelfrüh.

data.name: Saphir
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2001. Pedigree: 83/017/020 x 80/056/006. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Sladek
data.notes: Czech variety with Northern Brewer and Saaz in its ancestry.

data.name: Smaragd
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2005. Pedigree: Hallertauer Gold x Ku II/18. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang and Spalt.

data.name: Sorachi Ace
data.notes: Japanese-bred variety with Saaz in its ancestry.

data.name: Southern Cross
data.notes: New Zealand triploid variety from Smoothcone and a Californian x Fuggle research variety, released in 1994.

data.name: Sovereign
data.notes: British variety from open pollination of a Pioneer seedling.

data.name: Spalter
data.notes: German land variety (landrace). Grown in Germany in Spalt.

data.name: Spalter Select
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 1992. Pedigree: 76/018/080 x 71/016/007. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Sterling
data.notes: US aroma variety bred from Czech Saaz, released in 1998.

data.name: Strisselspalt
data.notes: French land variety.

data.name: Styrian Savinjski Golding
data.notes: Slovenian variety, a daughter of Fuggle.

data.name: Summit
data.notes: US variety bred from Nugget.

data.name: Super Galena
data.notes: High-alpha US variety from the Hopsteiner breeding programme.

data.name: Superdelic
data.notes: Triploid variety with European and North American ancestry, crossed in 2012 by Dr Ron Beatson in the NZ Hops / Plant & Food Research breeding programme; released 2023.

data.name: Sussex
data.notes: British dwarf variety found in 2005 as a chance seedling next to a field of Pilot in Northiam, Sussex.

data.name: Sybilla
data.notes: Polish variety bred from Lubelski.

data.name: Talus
data.notes: US variety from an open-pollinated Sabro (HBC 438) mother.

data.name: Tango
data.notes: Aroma variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2021. Pedigree: Cascade x Hüll breeding stock. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: TerraSurge
data.notes: High-alpha US variety from the Hop Breeding Company, released in 2026.

data.name: Tettnanger
data.notes: German land variety (landrace). Grown in Germany in Tettnang.

data.name: Titan
data.notes: Bittering variety bred by the Hop Research Center Hüll, released 2023. Pedigree: Polaris x 2007/040/501. Grown in Germany in Hallertau, Tettnang, Spalt and Elbe-Saale.

data.name: Topaz
data.notes: Australian variety bred by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: High Alpha Australia, Wye College.

data.name: Triskel
data.notes: French variety from Strisselspalt crossed with a male of the English variety Yeoman.

data.name: Triumph
data.notes: US public variety bred by the USDA from Nugget and a USDA male.

data.name: Tsingdao Flower
data.notes: Chinese variety related to Cluster.

data.name: Vanguard
data.notes: US aroma variety bred from Hallertauer and German aroma hops, similar to Hallertauer Mittelfrüh.

data.name: Vic Secret
data.notes: Australian variety bred by Hop Products Australia. Ancestry given by HPA: High Alpha Australia, Wye College.

data.name: Vista
data.notes: US public variety from the USDA breeding programme.

data.name: Vital
data.notes: Czech variety from breeding material derived from Agnus.

data.name: Wai-iti

data.name: Waimea
data.notes: New Zealand triploid variety with Late Cluster, Saaz and Fuggle in its parentage.

data.name: Wakatu
data.notes: New Zealand triploid aroma variety, two thirds Hallertauer Mittelfrüh; released in 1988 as NZ Hallertau Aroma and renamed Wakatu in 2011.

data.name: Whitbread Golding Variety (WGV)
data.notes: English variety bred from Bates' Brewer.

data.name: Willamette
data.notes: US variety, a daughter of Fuggle.

data.notes: British variety bred from Northern Brewer and Target.

data.notes: British variety bred from Challenger.

data.name: Zeus
